title: The Most Dangerous Game

teacherSummary.text: Big-game hunter Sanger Rainsford falls overboard near Ship-Trap Island and finds the chateau of General Zaroff, a Russian aristocrat bored with hunting animals who now hunts shipwrecked sailors. Rainsford refuses to join and becomes the prey for three days. He builds traps that kill a servant and a hound, then leaps into the sea. That night he waits in Zaroff's bedroom; they fight, and Rainsford sleeps in Zaroff's bed.
